demo.title: Run your projects from anywhere you can text
demo.body: CODM turns any conversation into an operations desk for your projects — code, deploys, files, whatever your agents can do. Your client reports the bug at lunch; by coffee the fix is deployed and the reply is in their chat.

router.body: Ten requests in one thread don’t queue — they run. Each becomes an issue with its own terminal session, working in parallel on your machine. Replies carry the label back, so answering a quote hits the right session every time.

features.title: Everything between the ping and the pull request
features.intro: Not a chatbot. Your agents can run anything the workspace allows — builds, tests, deploys, scripts, skills — driven entirely from chat.

cards.title: One chat, parallel work
cards.body: Every request gets its own issue and terminal. Your backlog drains while you’re in a meeting — ten asks, ten sessions, zero collisions.

cards.title: Replies route themselves
cards.body: Agent messages carry the issue key. Anyone in the chat can quote one to answer it — no syntax to learn, replies just land in the right session.

cards.title: A voice in the agent’s head
cards.body: Whisper “keep it behind the flag” mid-task — the agent adjusts, the client never sees it. Pause the thread and the mic is yours.

cards.title: Knows when to wait
cards.body: Rate limit, risky command, someone asked for a human — the agent stops, flags you, and holds the line until you approve, deny or take over.

cards.title: More than code
cards.body: Preview links, screenshots, exports, reports — every deliverable an agent produces is cataloged per thread, ready to reshare.

cards.title: Nothing leaves your machine
cards.body: No relay servers in your data path: code, keys and chats stay on the machine you own. Your account only signs you in — none of your work leaves.
